programme.title: Auftrag Auto
programme.desc: Auftrag Auto - (E04, Lehrprogramm, Deutschland, 2013) Große Klappe - viel dahinter: Alex Wesselsky, den Zuschauern auch bekannt als DER Checker ist ab sofort jeden Donnerstag mit dem neuen Format Auftrag Auto auf SPORT1 zu sehen. Zusammen mit der Rennfahrerin Cyndie Allemann beantwortet der PS-Fachmann kompetent und launig die Zuschauerfragen, die die Auto-Nation bewegen, und kürt in jeder Sendung aus jeweils drei vorgestellten Fahrzeugen den Sieger. SPORT1-Zuschauerin Heike aus Dresden steht auf kleine Krawallbüchsen. VW Polo GTI, Renault twingo und Ford Fiesta ST sind genau ihre Kragenweite. Sie selbst fährt voller Stolz einen Opel Corsa OPC Nürburgring-Edition mit 210 PS. Aber was ist eigentlich die krasseste Rennsemmel, die man in Deutschland gegen Geld kaufen kann? Das will die 22-jährige von Cyndie und Alex wissen.

programme.title: Auftrag Auto
programme.desc: Auftrag Auto - (E06, Lehrprogramm, Deutschland, 2013) Heute stehen nicht drei Autos, sondern nur eins im Mittelpunkt: Der Robin Reliant. Das Einsatzauto von Alex und Cyndie hat nur drei Räder, ist sehr kippelig und mindestens einmal pro Folge fällt Alex damit auf die Seite. Beifahrerin Cyndie hasst den Robin, Alex liebt ihn. SPORT1-Zuschauerin Isabel macht sich deshalb Sorgen. Sie fürchtet, dass sich die beiden verletzen könnten und fragt, ob Alex nicht ein Fahrertraining im Robin machen könnte. Rennfahrerin Cyndie ist sie sofort einverstanden und schlägt ein MINI-Fahrertraining vor, damit Alex endlich lernt, mit einem Sportwagen im Allgemeinen und dem Robin im Speziellen umzugehen.

programme.title: Die PS Profis - Mehr Power aus dem Pott
programme.desc: Die PS Profis - Mehr Power aus dem Pott - (E111, Lehrprogramm, Deutschland, 2016) PS Profis - Mehr Power aus dem Pott ist eine Gebrauchtwagen-Doku mit den Ruhrpott-Originalen Sidney Hoffmann und Jean Pierre, die im Auftrag von SPORT1-Zuschauern ab sofort wieder gemeinsam auf Autosuche gehen. In jeder Sendung erhalten Sid And JP den Auftrag, einen passenden Gebrauchten für einen Zuschauer zu finden. Dabei geben sie Tipps und Tricks, nennen die spezifischen Schwachstellen einzelner Modelle, verraten die Kniffe der Verkäufer und zeigen, dass man für wenig Geld gute gebrauchte Autos kaufen kann. Ab sofort sind beide PS Profis wieder gemeinsam am Start und machen gute Laune beim Autocheck.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Teleshopping - (Nachrichtenprogramm , Deutschland, 2026) Um einzukaufen, muss man nicht das Haus verlassen. Auch nach Ladenschluss sind mit dieser Sendung Einkäufe ganz bequem vom Sofa aus zu erledigen. Beim Teleshopping werden von den kompetenten Moderatoren innovative und exklusive Produkte aus den verschiedensten Bereichen wie Haushalt, Freizeit, Fitness oder Kosmetik präsentiert und können dann per Telefon oder Internet bestellt werden.

programme.title: Repair Shop - Kaputt gibt's nicht
programme.desc: The Repair Shop - (E01, Unterhaltungsmag., England, 2018) Repair Shop ist eine Factual-Entertainment-Show, in der erfahrene Restauratorinnen und Restauratoren liebgewonnene Familienerbstücke mit viel handwerklichem Können und Leidenschaft wieder zum Leben erwecken - bewegende Geschichten, beeindruckende Verwandlungen und emotionale Überraschungen inklusive., R.: Ben Borland, Ul.: Dominic Chinea (Self - Expert), Steven Fletcher (Self - Expert), Suzie Fletcher (Self - Expert), Catherine Guilder (Self - Expert), Alastair Simms (Self - Expert)

programme.title: Container Wars
programme.desc: Container Wars - (E27, Lehrfilmreihe, Vereinigte Staaten (von Amerika), 2014) Ab sofort werden auch im Hafen Geschäfte gemacht: In der neuen Serie Container Wars kommt der Inhalt von großen Schiffscontainern aus der ganzen Welt unter den Hammer. In diesem rasanten Business braucht es allerdings nicht nur einen dicken Geldbeutel, sondern auch ein gutes Auge und eiserne Nerven, um Erfolg zu haben. Den Auktionären bleiben nur wenige Minuten, um sich einen ersten Eindruck vom Inhalt der Container zu verschaffen. Daher weiß man auch erst nach der Versteigerung, ob sich das Geschäft gelohnt hat oder nicht. Die Auktionen übernimmt die lokale Berühmtheit John Kunkle, der immer den einen oder anderen Spruch parat hat. Zu den Bietern gehören das israelische Unternehmer-Duo Shlomi und Uzi, der charmante Südländer Jason, die beiden Kalifornier Ty und Mo, der erfahrene Matthew und die ehemalige Schönheitskönigin Deana, die sich in der Männerdomäne behaupten will., R.: Varios, Ul.: Matthew Thomas Gaus (Self), Jason R. Hughes (Self)

programme.title: NORMAL
programme.desc: Normal - (E37, Lehrprogramm, Deutschland, 2026) Als Projekt der Arbeitsgemeinschaft Behinderung und Medien e.V., die den Alltag behinderter Menschen seit über 30 Jahren dokumentiert, ist dieses Magazin nicht nicht nur ein Forum für Menschen mit einer Behinderung. Insbesondere soll auch nichtbehinderten Menschen das Leben mit einer Behinderung verständlich gemacht werden, um so ein besseres gemeinsames Zusammenleben möglich zu machen.

programme.title: Repair Shop - Kaputt gibt's nicht
programme.desc: The Repair Shop - (E02, Unterhaltungsmag., England, 2018) Repair Shop ist eine Factual-Entertainment-Show, in der erfahrene Restauratorinnen und Restauratoren liebgewonnene Familienerbstücke mit viel handwerklichem Können und Leidenschaft wieder zum Leben erwecken - bewegende Geschichten, beeindruckende Verwandlungen und emotionale Überraschungen inklusive., R.: Ben Borland, Ul.: Jay Blades (Self - Manager and Expert), Steven Fletcher (Self - Expert), William Kirk (Self - Expert), Lucia Scalisi (Self - Expert), Brenton West (Self - Expert)

programme.title: Container Wars
programme.desc: Container Wars - (E12, Lehrfilmreihe, Vereinigte Staaten (von Amerika), 2013) Ab sofort werden auch im Hafen Geschäfte gemacht: In der neuen Serie Container Wars kommt der Inhalt von großen Schiffscontainern aus der ganzen Welt unter den Hammer. In diesem rasanten Business braucht es allerdings nicht nur einen dicken Geldbeutel, sondern auch ein gutes Auge und eiserne Nerven, um Erfolg zu haben. Den Auktionären bleiben nur wenige Minuten, um sich einen ersten Eindruck vom Inhalt der Container zu verschaffen. Daher weiß man auch erst nach der Versteigerung, ob sich das Geschäft gelohnt hat oder nicht. Die Auktionen übernimmt die lokale Berühmtheit John Kunkle, der immer den einen oder anderen Spruch parat hat. Zu den Bietern gehören das israelische Unternehmer-Duo Shlomi und Uzi, der charmante Südländer Jason, die beiden Kalifornier Ty und Mo, der erfahrene Matthew und die ehemalige Schönheitskönigin Deana, die sich in der Männerdomäne behaupten will., R.: Michael McNamara, Ul.: Matthew Thomas Gaus (Self), Jason R. Hughes (Self), John Kunkle (Auctioneer), Deana Molle' (Self)

programme.title: Eastside Motors - Kaufrausch in Dresden
programme.desc: Eastside Motors - Kaufrausch in Dresden - (E01, Dokumentarfilm, Deutschland, 2022) Nächster Neuzugang im PS-Programm: Mit Eastside Motors - Kaufrausch in Dresden startet SPORT1 ein weiteres Autoformat und baut damit das Angebot im Motor-Bereich weiter aus. Wenn verrückte Karren auf leichten Wahnsinn treffen, kann nur die Mannschaft von Eastside Motors dahinterstecken. Von der Ost-Ikone Trabi, über die britische Landyacht Rolls Royce bis hin zum amerikanischen Schlachtross Hummer H1 - wer ein Fahrzeug mit Charakter sucht, wird auf dem Hof der Dresdner Autogesellschaft garantiert fündig. Um sich im verrückten Gebrauchtwagenmarkt zu behaupten, muss Boss Enrico Tetzlaff mit seinem Team vollen Einsatz zeigen, denn die Kohle scheffelt sich nicht von alleine.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: The Moody Blues: Days of Future Passed Live - (concert film, Canada, 2017) Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Milky Chance - Garorock Festival
programme.desc: Milky Chance: Live @ Garorock Festival 2017 - (concert film, France, 2017) The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album Blossom. And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop. With reggae vibrations that can rub shoulders with house elements, Milky Chance has one of the most singular sounds. With the presence of musicians on stage, and if we believe the listening of the new record, we can expect more electric concerts, more electronic and even more energetic than in the past!

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: Paul Simon: Live in New York City - (concert film, United States of America, 2012) During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. Kodachrome, Mother and Child Reunion, Gone At Last and The Obvious Child are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including Dazzling Blue, Rewrite, The Afterlife and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: Def Leppard - And There Will Be a Next Time
programme.desc: Def Leppard: And There Will Be a Next Time - Live in Detroit - (concert film, United States of America, 2017) As the sun began to set over a frenzied Detroit crowd, Def Leppard hits the stage in this mind-blowing audio and visual extravaganza that will change your concept of what a rock concert should be! Featuring their biggest hits, this 88 minute, 17 song concert features stunning performances of Pour Some Sugar On Me, Hysteria, Rocket, Photograph, Let's Get Rocked, Rock of Ages, Animal, Foolin', Let's Go, and many more! With stunning video walls, great musicianship, and their greatest hits make for an unforgettable concert experience!, R.: James Yukich

programme.title: Electric Light Orchestra - Live at Wembley
programme.desc: Electric Light Orchestra: Out of the Blue Tour Live at Wembley - (concert film, England, 1978) Captured live at London's Wembley Arena and directed by Mike Mansfield this space-age show will live forever in rock history as, quite literally, out of this world featuring a pioneering laser display, the first of its kind that set a precedent for subsequent rock shows. 'Standing in the Rain', 'Night in The Rain', 'Turn to Stone', 'Tight Rope', 'Telephone Line', 'Rock Aria', 'Wild West Hero', 'Show Down', 'Sweet Talking Woman', 'Roll Over Beethoven'., R.: Mike Mansfield, Ul.: Tony Curtis (Self - Introduction)

programme.title: Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Live from MSG - (documentary, United States of America, 2009) History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists., R.: Eric Clapton

programme.title: Radiohead - The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement
programme.desc: Radiohead - The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement - (concert film, England, 2011) The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement is a 2011 live video album by the English alternative rock band Radiohead, performing their eighth album, The King of Limbs (2011).

programme.title: Ozzy Osbourne - God Bless Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: God Bless Ozzy Osbourne - (concert film, United States of America, 2011) Ozzy Osbourne is one of the most iconic figures in rock and one of the founding fathers of heavy metal. God Bless Ozzy Osbourne tells for the first time the story of his career from the founding of Black Sabbath through to solo stardom and his wider fame beyond. These were the wild days of his prodigious drug and alcohol intake, of biting the head from a dove at a record company meeting and biting into a bat on stage but also of the tragic death of Randy Rhoads and the reality TV show The Osbournes. The film follows Ozzy's torturous and emotionally fraught journey from excess to sobriety, which Ozzy regards as his greatest accomplishment. Featuring never before seen footage, new interviews with Ozzy himself, his family, his bandmates, and those who both inspired him and were inspired by him, this is the first film to take viewers inside the mind and psyche of this legendary figure., R.: Mike Fleiss, Ul.: Ozzy Osbourne (Self), Aimee Osbourne (Self), Jack Osbourne (Self), Kelly Osbourne (Self), Louis Osbourne (Self)

programme.title: Linkin Park - Road To Revolution
programme.desc: Linkin Park: Road to Revolution - Live at Milton Keynes - (music video, England, 2008) Recorded live at the Milton Keynes stadium in England, Road to Revolution brings the 2 Grammy winning rock band Linkin Park in an explosive performance to over 55,000 fans, the biggest audience in the 6-year Revolution Project tour. To the audience's delight, the set list includes mega-hits like Crawling, In The End, One Step Closer and What I've Done., R.: Blue Leach, Ul.: Chester Bennington (Self), Rob Bourdon (Self), Brad Delson (Self), Phoenix Farrell (Self), Joseph Hahn (Self)

programme.title: Lady Gaga - Live in London
programme.desc: Live in London 2013: Lady Gaga - (concert film, England, 2013) Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: Aura; MANiCURE; Artpop; Jewels N' Drugs ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista; Sexxx Dreams, Swine; and I Wanna Be With You, a song that transformed into Dope for ARTPOP. During the concert, captured stunningly in HD, Gaga says that she's a bit like Dorothy right now. The stage is her Kansas, the crowd is her family, and their reunion is pure magic. Lady Gaga, her dancers, and her band traverse through visual and musical themes of love, sex, violence, beauty, danger, empowerment, hustle, lust, and above all ART. Throughout, Gaga lays her heart bare for the audience and the cameras with every note sung and every word spoken.

programme.title: Kylie Minogue - Live in London
programme.desc: Kylie 3D - Aphrodite-Les Folies - Live in London - (concert film, England, 2011) Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish. The 2-hour show proved to be one of the most elaborate and extravagant productions ever staged by a pop performer, a multi-million dollar visual and musical feast, that delighted critics and fans alike wherever it played. Now Kylie's fans can re-live the experience with this amazing 2-hour document, which includes all of her best-known modern hits- Can t Get You Out Of My Head, Spinning Around- as well as her four Billboard Club smashes from 2010's acclaimed Aphrodite album including All The Lovers and Get Outta My Way., R.: Kylie Minogue

programme.title: John Mellencamp - Plain Spoken: Live in Chicago
programme.desc: John Mellencamp: Plain Spoken - Live in Chicago - (concert film, United States of America, 2015) John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days., R.: Paul Dugdale

programme.title: Bastille - Reading and Leeds Festival
programme.desc: Bastille: Reading and Leeds Festival - (concert film, England, 2022) The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of annual music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds, England. The events both happen on the bank holiday weekend in August (on Friday, Saturday, Sunday), and share the same bill (occasionally with one or two exceptions). The festival's origins date to the Beaulieu Jazz Festival (1956-1961) which became the National Jazz Festival in 1961 (The National Jazz and Blues Festival in 1963) and settled in Reading in 1971. In 1999 a second leg was added at Leeds. Featuring : Bastille.

programme.title: Everest
programme.desc: Temeljeno na istinitoj priči – tragična planinarska ekspedicija na Mt. Everestu je uništena kada planinu pogodi jaka snježna oluja. U glavnoj ulozi je Jake Gyllenhaal.

programme.title: Ponos i predrasude
programme.desc: Životi pet sestara u georgijanskoj Engleskoj okrenu se naglavce kada se bogati mladić sa svojim prijateljem doseli u njihovo susjedstvo. Film je temeljen na romanu Jane Austen.

programme.title: Samo je jedan Jimmy Grimble
programme.desc: Stidljivi mančesterski školarac uspijeva skupiti hrabrost da nogometnu momčad svoje škole povede do finala kupa.

programme.title: Vojvotkinja
programme.desc: Kronika o životu plemkinje Georgiane iz 18. stoljeća koju su napadali zbog njezina ekstravagantnog političkog i privatnog života, ali koja je unatoč tomu postala središtem pomodnog društva.

programme.title: Angry birds film
programme.desc: Doznajte zašto su ptice tako ljutite. Kad na otok nastanjen pticama koje ne lete dođu tajanstvene male zelene svinje, na trima izopćenicima je da otkriju što svinje smjeraju.

programme.title: Zohan je zakon!
programme.desc: Izraelski vojnik specijalnih snaga lažira svoju smrt da bi se mogao pojaviti kao frizer u New Yorku.

programme.title: Sajam taštine
programme.desc: Odrastajući u siromaštvu u Londonu početkom 19. stoljeća, mlada djevojka koristi svu svoju duhovitost, lukavstvo i seksualnost da se uzdigne i osvoji englesko društvo.

programme.title: Riba ribi grize rep
programme.desc: Kad sin gangsterskog šefa lovišta morskih pasa slučajno bude ubijen tijekom lova, njegov potencijalni plijen i njegov brat vegetarijanac odluče iskoristiti incident u svoju korist.

programme.title: Dilema
programme.desc: Dva najbolja prijatelja i poslovna partnera pokušavaju proslaviti svoju tvrtku kada jedan od njih vidi ženu drugog kako ljubi drugog muškarca te mora smisliti kako mu reći što je vidio.

programme.title: Udovice
programme.desc: Četiri žene koje nemaju ništa zajedničko osim duga koji su im ostavili njihovi pokojni muževi upleteni u kriminal, uzimaju sudbinu u svoje ruke i kuju zavjeru da stvore budućnost pod svojim uvjetima.

programme.title: Prizivanje duhova: Porijeklo zla
programme.desc: 1967. u Los Angelesu, udovica i njezine kćeri dodaju novi trik kako bi ojačale svoj posao s prijevarama sa seansama pozivajući zlu prisutnost u svoj dom, ne shvaćajući koliko je to opasno.

programme.title: Jedan jedini
programme.desc: Gabriel Yulaw je policajac koji se mora suočiti sa zlokobnim oblikom sebe, koji je odbjegao iz naprednog, paralelnog svemira i želi ga ubiti. U glavnoj je ulozi Jet Li.

programme.title: Vojvotkinja
programme.desc: Kronika o životu plemkinje Georgiane iz 18. stoljeća koju su napadali zbog njezina ekstravagantnog političkog i privatnog života, ali koja je unatoč tomu postala središtem pomodnog društva.

programme.title: Rent-a-mama
programme.desc: Uspješna, neudana poslovna žena koja silno želi imati dijete dozna da je neplodna te angažira ženu iz radničke klase da joj bude zamjenska majka.

programme.title: Kapetan Gaćeša: Prvi epski film
programme.desc: Dva ludo maštovita šaljivca hipnotiziraju mrzovoljnog ravnatelja da pomisli da je smiješno entuzijastičan, ali nevjerojatno glup superheroj u donjem rublju.

programme.title: Razum i osjećaji
programme.desc: Kate Winslet i Emma Thompson glume kćeri udovice koja je otkrila opasnosti ljubavi i života u ovoj klasičnoj romantičnoj drami.

programme.title: Sjećanja jedne gejše
programme.desc: Žena otkriva kako je nadvladala svoje korijene iz ribarskog sela i postala jedna od najslavnijih gejši u Japanu.

programme.title: Dvije sestre za kralja
programme.desc: Ova povijesna drama prati oštru borbu sestara Mary (Scarlett Johansson) i Anne Boleyn (Natalie Portman), dok se trude steći naklonost kralja Henrika VIII.

programme.title: Stuart Mali 2
programme.desc: Michael J. Fox posuđuje glas Stuartu Malom u nastavku o šarmantnom sićušnom junaku Stuartu. Ovaj put mora putovati kroz grad kako bi spasio novog prijatelja, Margala, od zlikovca.

programme.title: Dolazak
programme.desc: Lingvist surađuje s vojskom kako bi komunicirao s izvanzemaljskim oblicima života nakon što se dvanaest misterioznih svemirskih letjelica pojavi u svijetu.

programme.title: Suvišna okrutnost
programme.desc: Vlasnik otrcanog bara u teksaškom gradiću otkriva da jedan od zaposlenika ima ljubavnu vezu s njegovom suprugom.

programme.title: Patrolne šape
programme.desc: Pridružite se neustrašivom čoporu koji čini šest kuca - Čejs, Maršal, Roki, Zuma, Rabl i Skaj. Predvođeni desetogodišnjim Rajderom, spremni su da se suoče sa svakim izazovom! Za ovu hrabru družinu...

programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: "Igram svoju igru" je TV serijal posvećen djeci, našim sportskim talentima.

programme.title: VOA - Američki san
programme.desc: Ovi filmovi će vam pružiti priliku da svoju radoznalost zadovoljite putem upečatljivih vizuelnih prikaza i izvanrednog pripovijedanja.

programme.title: Profil
programme.desc: Emisija iz oblasti kulture.

programme.title: Koncert
programme.desc: Uživajte uz muzički program koji nam donosi snimke raznih, muzičkih koncerata.

programme.title: Vratiće se rode
programme.desc: Junaci serije Vratiće se rode su Ekser i Švabo, dvojica prijatelja koji preživljavaju od danas do sjutra preprodajući ukradenu robu, najčešće parfeme sumnjivog porijekla, stalno su u dugovima i na...

programme.title: Alternativni puls
programme.desc: "Alternativni puls" rođen je iz iskrene i duboke želje da pružimo vidljivost, glas i prostor jednoj snažnoj, raznolikoj i autentičnoj muzičkoj sceni - alternativnoj sceni Crne Gore, koja neumorno i...

programme.title: Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Pedesete godine prošlog vijeka. Tri sestre, Katarina, Zora i Cvita nedavno su ostale bez oca i zaštitnika. Kako bi obezbjedila svojim sestrama pristojan život, Katarina pristaje da se uda za sina...

programme.title: Stiven Spilberg
programme.desc: Ovaj francuski dokumentarac istražuje život i karijeru Stivena Spilberga, fokusirajući se na njegovo odrastanje i jevrejsko porijeklo. Film kroz arhivske snimke i intervjue pokazuje kako su lične...

programme.title: Sounday live
programme.desc: Uživajte i opustite se uz miks najvećih hitova koji smo pripremili za vas! U emisiji "Sounday live" imate priliku da slušate afirmisane izvođače, ali i pjevače i grupe koji su na početku muzičke...

programme.title: Pogledi iz domovine
programme.desc: Pogledi iz domovine emisija koja promoviše ruralna područja, prikazuje životne i iskrene ljudske priče. Vraća u prošlost, podsjećajući nas na tradiciju, običaje, korijene i zavičaj.

programme.title: Naša priča
programme.desc: Priča o životu, porodici, uspjehu, karijeri, ljepoti, umjetnosti. Zajedno oktrivamo, djelimo i stvaramo priče koje nas povezuju. U našoj priči najbolje priče pričamo zajedno.

programme.title: Izbor iz jutarnjeg programa
programme.desc: Donosimo vam izbor iz najvažnijih vijesti i informacija, reportaža i priloga emitovanih u jutarnjem programu.

programme.title: Stiven Spilberg
programme.desc: Ovaj francuski dokumentarac istražuje život i karijeru Stivena Spilberga, fokusirajući se na njegovo odrastanje i jevrejsko porijeklo. Film kroz arhivske snimke i intervjue pokazuje kako su lične...

programme.title: Ljepša strana dana - nedjeljno popodne
programme.desc: "Ljepša strana dana" nedeljom popodne donosi pozitivne, vedre i interesantne teme iz Crne Gore i regiona, kao i zanimljive segmente o aktuelnim društvenim dešavanjima.

programme.title: Mladovanje
programme.desc: Mladi, ostvareni ljudi u nekoj oblasti govore o putu koji su prešli do uspjeha, koliko je teško uspjeti, kakve prepreke stoje pred mladima danas u Crnoj Gori, šta bi trebalo mijenjati, zašto su...

programme.title: Koncert
programme.desc: Uživajte uz muzički program koji nam donosi snimke raznih, muzičkih koncerata.

programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: "Igram svoju igru" je TV serijal posvećen djeci, našim sportskim talentima.

programme.title: Gradovi
programme.desc: Emisija o gradovima Crne Gore. Saznajte brojne zanimljive činjenice o istoriji, tradiciji i kulturi gradova u kojima živimo!

programme.title: Još smo mi zeleni
programme.desc: Emisija posvećena mladima, namijenjena da obrazuje i prikaže mladima u Crnoj Gori novi ugao gledanja na njihovu okolinu i svijet.
